Trial: 14 days, full access, no charge until it ends. You’re on the Basic plan during the trial.
Plans (paid): Basic, Growth, Pro (new customers can sign up for these).

What’s not in Basic (needs Growth): affiliate program, advanced automations, cohort courses, remove Kajabi branding, webhooks, Universal Inbox.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
The simplest way to use Kajabi the first time is to follow the Foundations checklist in order (it’s the “what to do next” path).
From your Dashboard, open the checklist under your metrics and do the steps in this order: validate your idea, set your brand colors, add your instructor details, build a waitlist, connect a payment method, create your first product, price it, design your website, then test the whole purchase journey yourself before you promote it.
If you want, use Cofounder from your first login to turn your idea into a clear action plan (it shows up as a checklist you can pin to your dashboard). 
When you’re ready to sell, go to Sales → Pricing → + New Offer, choose your product, set a price, then Save and Finish. 
Test what customers will see by creating a test customer account (Contacts → + Add Contacts → Add Single Contact → enter name + email → check Grant offers → select an offer → Save). 
Next action: open the Foundations checklist on your Dashboard and do step 1 (validate your idea).

• Just now
Seen • Just now
Kajabi doesn’t have a single “return policy” for your Kajabi subscription, but refunds depend on what you bought. 
If you bought a course or membership hosted on Kajabi, refunds are handled by the site owner (the creator), not by us. You’ll need to use the contact details in your confirmation or welcome email, or their website’s Contact Us page.
If you bought a website template from our Template Store, those are final. Once the template files are delivered, refunds, exchanges, or cancellations aren’t offered. 
One extra note: in Germany, some online purchases may have a 14-day “cooling-off” right, but it doesn’t apply to every offer.
